display_long_description:
Imagine visualising your geoscience models and data in virtual reality while interacting with your colleague’s 3D Avatars. BaselineZ accelerates experiences, knowledge sharing, and decision-making. Enhance your 2D screen workflows with immersive and fun ways to work, share knowledge, and collaborate on 3D Subsurface Projects from anywhere.

FREE (NO REGISTRATION REQUIRED)
•	Explore sample geoscience projects in Virtual Reality
•	Data visualisation features
 
FREE (REGISTRATION REQUIRED)
•	Explore sample geoscience projects in 3D
•	Access to the Web Portal
•	Connect with anyone from anywhere
•	Create your 3D avatar
•	Create up to 5 data rooms
•	Upload a 3D Models to view in 3D 
•	Display 3D objects, 2D images, videos and PDF files
•	Data visualisation features

ADDITIONAL OPTIONS BASELINEZ 
•	Your own 3D Data Room
 
JOIN FROM ANY DEVICE
•	BaselineZ is available in VR, MR, Mobile and Tablet
